Strategy: Scale the wide band reward to a full item, testing whether a bigger item-scaled bonus for leftovers between twenty-five and fifty helps more. It may help by committing harder to the good window, but may fail if the bonus overwhelms tight fits.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (item if r - item >= 25 and r - item <= 50 else 0) for r in bins]
```
